rationale: Guidelines whose stated aims include treatment; they report clinicopathology of severe babesiosis and drug efficacy percentages (Babesan 96.5%, Forticarb 93.3% etc.) plus Emidonol shortening recovery and reducing complications. Sample size not reported, so n_dogs is null.
Retrospective review of CBC reticulocyte dot plots in dogs with babesiosis; no clinical presentation of treated dogs and no treatment or outcome reported.
Descriptive haematology of 101 positive dogs (anaemia, thrombocytopenia); abstract describes no treatment or outcome.
Single case report of a dog with clinical signs and pancytopenia, focused on spurious reticulocyte counts; the abstract gives no treatment or outcome.
